records.name: FX / libfx

features_notes.durable_resume: SDK lease/fencing/log/checkpoint protocol; local workflow queue explicitly is not durable and persisted files alone do not restart wakeups.
features_notes.approvals: Permission gate has an explicit yolo bypass; fallback is read-only/non-irreversible only.
features_notes.os_sandbox: No OS isolation boundary established from inspected SDK/runtime paths.
features_notes.hooks: Host engine/tool adapter seams; not asserted as the same mechanism as a product hook bus.
features_notes.subagents: Runtime supports subagent scheduling; no multi-host crash test performed.

dims.loop: Zig runtime orchestrates model/tool turns; JavaScript SDK separates engine and session hosting.
dims.providers: Model adapters/default gateway setup; native and WASM builds have different host capabilities.
dims.tools: Host tools require explicit idempotent declaration; permission and concurrency policies are separate.
dims.context: Compaction handles manual/auto/overflow triggers and searchable original records with summarized notes.
dims.state: Outer SDK lease, fencing, log and checkpoints; explicit ambiguous-effect recovery and non-durable local queue.
dims.safety: Permission decisions including yolo bypass; no general sandbox guarantee inferred from engine implementation.
dims.extensibility: Native addon/WASM SDK engine adapters, custom tools, skills and MCP.
dims.multi_agent: Parallel eligible tools/subagent scheduling bounded by host capabilities.
dims.surfaces: CLI/ACP/headless plus JavaScript SDK over native or WASM engine.
dims.observability: Durable logs, checkpoint/effect state and tool accounting; no OTel guarantee established.

records.one_liner: An experimental embeddable engine with unusually explicit durable-host contracts and idempotency requirements.
key_insights: The JavaScript SDK separates the native/WASM engine from durable-session hosting.
Tools must explicitly declare idempotency; ambiguous non-idempotent effects are not blindly replayed.
The local workflow queue is not durable even when session files persist.

records.name: AgentOS

features_notes.durable_resume: SQLite-backed filesystem can survive dispose/recreate; not model-turn replay or proof all live processes resume.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Execution isolation uses V8/Wasm plus sidecar permission profiles, not an OS microVM; partial marks this distinct boundary.
features_notes.approvals: Permission profiles enforce access; no model-facing human approval product established.
features_notes.subagents: Not applicable to a model-free execution substrate.
features_notes.http_server: Internal sidecar/network support is not a general agent application HTTP service.

dims.loop: Not applicable: execution runtime receives code/files/process requests, not a model-driven agent loop.
dims.providers: Not applicable: host supplies any model layer externally.
dims.tools: Embedded filesystem/process/network/host-function interfaces suitable for an external agent tool adapter.
dims.context: Not applicable to prompt compaction; runtime manages mounts, packages and filesystem resources.
dims.state: Optional SQLite-backed filesystem persistence across runtime recreation; no agent-effect replay supplied.
dims.safety: V8/Wasm execution with explicit permission profiles; high-level AgentOS and lower-level secure defaults differ.
dims.extensibility: Host functions, mount/package configuration and sidecar integration.
dims.multi_agent: Not applicable: external harness must schedule or coordinate agents.
dims.surfaces: TypeScript embedding with Rust execution/sidecar components and code-execution examples.
dims.observability: Runtime/sidecar infrastructure; advertised benchmarks not reproduced and agent tracing supplied by host.

records.one_liner: An embeddable isolated execution substrate to put beneath a harness, not a competing model-loop framework.
key_insights: AgentOS supplies an execution environment beneath a harness and contains no model-driven agent loop.
V8/Wasm and sidecar permission profiles are distinct from an OS microVM boundary.
Persisted SQLite filesystem state is not a checkpoint of agent turns or all running processes.

records.name: OpenHarness

features_notes.durable_resume: Atomic JSON file snapshots for sessions; latest/session files and external effects are not a single transaction.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Optional Docker path uses --network none even when domains are listed; local host path remains distinct.
features_notes.approvals: Sensitive-file deny checked first, then tool allow/deny; broad allowed_tools can bypass later path/command checks.
features_notes.agents_md: CLAUDE.md/.claude/rules discovery, not literal AGENTS.md parity.
features_notes.worktrees: Swarm/worktree manager includes validated slugs and metadata; no independent concurrent-Git lifecycle test.
features_notes.in_process_sdk: Python internals are reusable; independent stable SDK contract not established.
features_notes.http_server: No general authenticated HTTP agent service established by this review.
features_notes.plugins: Artifact manifests expose tool/hook/skill/agent/MCP capabilities; not an affiliation with similarly named vendors.

dims.loop: Query streams model responses, compacts/retries and serially or concurrently executes calls before appending all results.
dims.providers: Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible/Copilot/subscription pathways; unsupported voice configuration fails explicitly.
dims.tools: Pydantic inputs and async tool execution, per-call read-only classification and Anthropic-shaped schemas.
dims.context: Old-result microcompaction then summary compaction; upward instruction and rules discovery.
dims.state: Atomic session/latest JSON writes; restart history lacks a transactional external-effect journal.
dims.safety: Ordered permission policy plus optional network-disabled Docker executor; broad allow rules alter later checks.
dims.extensibility: Plugins package skills, commands, agents, tools, hooks and MCP definitions.
dims.multi_agent: Delegation/swarm/worktree surfaces; only static lifecycle review performed.
dims.surfaces: Python Query core with CLI/headless and terminal UI; stable SDK and general HTTP service not established.
dims.observability: Streaming events, hook events, session records and provider failures; no live telemetry validation.

records.one_liner: A broad open-source coding-agent implementation with explicit permission ordering and optional Docker isolation.
key_insights: The coding product combines explicit permission ordering with rich plugin and hook surfaces.
Broad tool allowances can bypass later path/command checks, while sensitive-path denial runs earlier.
Atomic session JSON writes do not make external tool effects transactional; Docker execution is optional.

checks: FX native/JS package seams and explicit tool idempotency contract inspected
FX durable lease/fencing and local queueDurable=false limitation inspected
FX permission bypass/fallback and compaction records inspected
AgentOS high-level vs low-level profile defaults compared
AgentOS persistence example distinguished from process checkpoint/replay
AgentOS model-free category and null model-layer scores used
OpenHarness parallel tool-result append and session atomic write boundaries inspected
OpenHarness permission precedence and Docker network configuration inspected
verification.limits: Static source review only. No cloned source installed, imported or executed; no provider calls, benchmarks, crash-injection, sandbox attacks or UI integration tests.
